findings.english_quote: so that each might ὑνερπολῇ and deliver oracles
findings.issue: The first predicate of the purpose clause remains untranslated. No defensible contextual English meaning for the supplied ὑνερπολῇ has been established without changing its letters. The independently image-checked transcription establishes the printed reading; this is not an allegation of OCR error or a request to repeat print verification. The proposed ὑπερπολῇ is a conjecture, not the supplied text, and neither its correctness nor its contextual meaning is established by the surrounding argument. The draft honestly discloses this problem, but disclosure does not supply the missing English meaning. The other surviving clauses have defensible renderings, with material interpretive alternatives adequately disclosed.
findings.suggested_revision: Provide lexical or historical-orthographic evidence establishing the identity and contextual meaning of the printed ὑνερπολῇ. Keep any proposed correction explicitly distinguished from that reading; do not silently substitute ὑπερπολῇ or a guessed English equivalent. Until the missing meaning is supported, retain the disclosed defect and blocking status. Any proposed replacement must undergo fresh review.
